cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant harbour city known for the iconic Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge and Bondi Beach.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Australia's cultural capital, famous for its laneway cafes, street art, coffee and sporting events.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A dazzling mix of neon skyscrapers, ancient shrines, world-class food and efficient transport.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Japan's former imperial capital, home to thousands of temples, traditional tea houses and gardens.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Famous for Sugarloaf Mountain, Christ the Redeemer, samba and the beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: Brazil's largest city, with a huge food scene, museums, nightlife and a rich cultural mix.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The largest religious monument in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, built in the 12th century.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: The white marble mausoleum in Agra, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World and a symbol of love.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A tropical island with a turquoise lagoon, overwater bungalows and white sandy beaches.

beaches.name: Whitehaven Beach, Australia
beaches.description: Seven kilometres of pure white silica sand on Whitsunday Island, next to the Great Barrier Reef.
